subject: CloudCart renewal: proof-of-performance & capacity bump
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@cloudcart.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: Tomas Jensen <tomas@cloudcart.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal discussion + independent benchmark request

Hi Grace,

We're approaching our renewal on May 15 and we'd like to share what's changed on our side. A vendor (internal benchmarking team) will run a short proof-of-performance next week comparing Redwood against a competitor (NimbusAI) because finance is pushing for a cost/latency re-evaluation.

Can you send:
- an agreed benchmark plan (what workloads to run / test script)
- expected latency percentiles for our current 8k token median prompt set
- options for a short-term capacity bump if we need more throughput during Q2 marketing spikes

We're not trying to be adversarial — just need numbers to present to procurement. Rajiv from Optimize.ai will consult the benchmark.

Thanks,
Elaine
VP, Engineering, CloudCart

---
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Park <elaine@cloudcart.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion + independent benchmark request

Elaine — thanks for the heads up and the context. We appreciate CloudCart being transparent.

Quick answers up front:
- We'll provide a short benchmark plan and a secure link to the test harness. See attached (cloudcart_benchmark_request.pdf).
- For your 8k token median prompts, P50 ~ 310ms, P95 ~ 980ms on your current reservation (r5-dedicated profile). We will provide distribution charts in the detailed report.
- We can offer a temporary +30% capacity bump for 45 days (no SLA change) and a discounted rate for that period.

Next steps I propose: Redwood-led joint run (we host the harness for the first run to keep parity), then CloudCart runs a follow-up in your environment. I’ll loop in Marcus and David to scope infra and the configuration diff.

Grace
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: cloudcart_benchmark_request.pdf

---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Apr 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: CloudCart benchmark plan / config notes

Grace / team — initial notes for the joint run:
- Use CloudCart prompt set v3 (referenced in the attached config_diff.xlsx). We need to ensure tokenization parity; CloudCart uses a custom preprocessor that strips emojis — flagged.
- Test harness: 3 runs of 1,000 requests each, sequence lengths sampled from observed distribution (avg 8k tokens, tail to 14k).
- Metrics: P50/P90/P95 latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, cost per 1k tokens.
- Baseline model: rwd-llama-78b-q4f (current in production). Competitor will likely run a 70B fp16.

I'll prep the harness container and ephemeral credentials. Evelyn, can you confirm whether we can host the first run on our dedicated pool for CloudCart next week?

Marcus
Solutions Engineering

Attachment: config_diff.xlsx

---
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Apr 2026 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudCart benchmark plan / config notes

We have capacity windows next Wed/Thu where we can spin a small dedicated pool for the joint run. Need CloudCart to confirm traffic shaping (ramp profile). Also recommend enabling prefix-caching with the test harness to emulate production traffic — that will surface realistic cost numbers.

Evelyn
Platform Ops

---
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Park <elaine@cloudcart.com>, Tomas Jensen <tomas@cloudcart.com>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv@optimize.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion + independent benchmark request

Elaine/Tomas — thanks. Proposed timeline attached in redwood_proofplan_v1.pdf: joint Redwood-hosted run next Wednesday (2026-04-08), CloudCart follow-up run in your environment the week after.

Key commercial note: Given the competitive review, we can extend a renewal term option with a 10% commit discount if CloudCart signs the renewal before May 1 and accepts a one-time 45-day capacity burst addendum. This discount is limited to the renewal term and tied to the capacity commit.

We’ll also include a clause for a post-run technical review and a 30-day performance SLA credit if the joint run shows Redwood underperforming our stated P95.

Please confirm the joint run date and whether Rajiv will need any special access for the harness.

Grace

Attachment: redwood_proofplan_v1.pdf

Grace — thanks for the clear plan and the timeline. We ran the Nimbus quick check yesterday and saw their P95 ~740ms on our scripts, roughly comparable. CloudCart leadership wants the Redwood joint run and the commercial term you proposed to be on the table for final decision.

We confirm joint run on Wed 2026-04-15 and Rajiv will participate. Please send the DocuSign link for the short-term capacity addendum and the renewal term so procurement can review.
